user.title: Connect Mira
user.description:
Usually Home Assistant finds Mira by itself, and it shows up under **Discovered**. If not, enter the address of the machine Mira runs on, with port 8787. On the same machine as Home Assistant that is `http://localhost:8787`.

No Mira yet? One line of Docker is enough, no config file needed: [setup in five steps]({guide}).

confirm.title: Add Mira
confirm.description: Mira found at {url}. Click Next to configure.

pair.title: Pairing code
pair.description:
This Mira was paired with a Home Assistant before. To pair again you need a **pairing code**. On the machine Mira runs on:

`docker exec mira /app/mira pair`

The code appears there and on Mira's page {url}. It is valid for 15 minutes and used when pairing.

token.title: Mira's access token
token.description: This Mira has its access token in its `mira.yaml` (`server.token`). Enter that token here.

model_source.title: AI model (LLM)
model_source.description:
Mira needs an AI model (LLM) to think with. Where does it come from?

- **From Home Assistant**: an AI integration you already set up; Mira takes over its key, you need not enter it again.
- **OpenAI, Gemini, …**: you need a key from the provider.
- **Own server**: e.g. LM Studio, Ollama or llama.cpp, with its address.{error}

model_key.title: Key for {provider}
model_key.description: Enter your API key for {provider}. You get it in your account with the provider. It goes to Mira only and is not shown again.{error}

model_server.title: Own server
model_server.description: The address of the server **as Mira sees it**, with `/v1` at the end, e.g. `http://192.168.1.30:1234/v1`. `localhost` is the machine Mira runs on. A key only if the server wants one.{error}

model.title: Choose the model
model.description: These are the models {server} offers. Mira tries the model with a short request before keeping it; on your own server that may take a minute while the model loads.{error}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Mira at this address.
error.bad_code: The code is wrong or expired. Make a new one with `docker exec mira /app/mira pair`.
error.model_unreachable: Mira cannot reach this address. Check it as Mira sees it; a server on another machine must accept connections from the network.{error}
error.model_bad_key: The provider refused the key. Check it and enter it again.{error}
error.model_no_model: The server does not know this model, or it is not loaded.{error}
error.model_no_tools: The model answered, but does not use tools. Mira needs that to switch and look things up; please choose another model.{error}
error.model_server_error: The server answered with an error.{error}

abort.no_id: The agent did not announce an id; update it.

create_entry.default:
Mira is set up and answers in the assistants you chose.

What Mira may see and switch you decide under **Settings → Voice assistants → Expose entities**.

data_description.timeout: After this the satellite says a short error instead of staying silent.
data_description.sidebar: Mira's web UI as a page in Home Assistant; who is no admin sees only their memory, the house's and the guide. Each user can also hide it in their own sidebar.
data_description.web_search: Mira looks up on the web what she cannot know: opening hours, results, news. Switch it off if you use another search.
data_description.persona: How Mira sounds: tone, humour, how short she answers. Appended to her fixed rules, for voice, Telegram and announcements. Answer length per channel and lists she handles herself.

persons.title: Settings for persons
persons.description: Every person in Home Assistant is a person for Mira too. Expand one and set what Mira needs on top; it is stored on the person itself. Left empty, there are no settings. {error}

data.alone_is_me: Alone at home, the satellites are me

data_description.alone_is_me: When you are the only person at home, Mira treats the voice satellites as you: your memory, your private messages.
data_description.channels: Notify targets that are this person's, in order: e.g. a chat of HA's Telegram integration, the companion app. Personal messages go to the first that works; a Telegram chat here is also how Mira knows the person when they write.
data_description.accept_from: Messages from people; Mira's own (tasks, reminders, warnings) always arrive.

satellites.title: Settings for satellites
satellites.description: Every Assist satellite with an area speaks in its area. Expand one and set what comes on top; it is stored on the satellite itself, the room is its area. {error}

data_description.presence: Motion at any of them starts an announcement, e.g. hallway and living room.
data_description.morning: When one of the motion sensors notices someone coming in, Mira says what is waiting. Off: she only tells when asked or after an answer ("By the way …"). The indicator (LED ring or overlay) shows it either way.
data_description.indicator: Shows waiting messages, e.g. the LED ring of the satellite.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Queue a message. The agent announces it on a satellite when someone is in a room, or sends it privately.

text.name: Text
text.description: What to say, one or two spoken sentences.

details.name: Details
details.description: The long form, for follow-up questions.

importance.name: Importance
importance.description: 0 not worth mentioning, 1 by the way, 2 important today, 3 urgent.

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.description: house, or a person: the HA person id (e.g. anna).

confidentiality.name: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidential messages are only spoken when the agent policy allows it, otherwise sent privately.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: An open message with the same key is updated instead of duplicated.

expires_in.name: Expires in
expires_in.description: Duration like 12h; afterwards the message is dropped. Default 24h.

task.name: Task
task.description: The automation's id ({{ this.attributes.id }}): the message shows in the task's log.

assess.name: Assess
assess.description: Mira judges what happened against the goal, with the data she looks up and condenses; if it is worth it, she words a message and delivers it like any other. Answers importance, spoken and message_id.

goal.name: Goal
goal.description: What this task is for, in the user's words.

data.name: Data
data.description: List of entries with entity_id and view; view state, same_hour (last hour against the same hour on 14 days) day (today so far against the same weekdays) or upcoming (a calendar's events to the end of tomorrow).

memory.name: Memory
memory.description: relevant: profile and matching facts; profile; none.

cooldown.name: Cooldown
cooldown.description: Like 6h: within it the task only reports again when it gets more important.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Off: only the verdict, no message (dry run).

receiver.name: Receiver
receiver.description: house, or a person: the HA person id (e.g. anna).

confidentiality.name: Confidentiality
confidentiality.description: Confidential messages are only spoken when the agent policy allows it.

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: An open message with the same key is updated instead of duplicated.

task.name: Task
task.description: The automation's id ({{ this.attributes.id }}): its judgements share a log and earlier verdicts.

decide.name: Decide
decide.description: Mira answers a yes/no question with the data she looks up; no message. Use with response_variable and a template condition.

data.name: Data
data.description: List of entries with entity_id and view, as for Assess.
